problemStatement.formal: Parametrize all pairs (a,b) with (a+b)|ab using coprime factorizations and determine the asymptotic count in {1,...,N}.
problemStatement.plain: Explicitly describe all pairs of positive integers whose sum divides their product, and count how many such pairs exist up to N.
whyMatters: Structural foundation for Erdős #327 avoidance problem
Connects unit fractions to coprime factorization theory

proven: Coprime construction produces valid sum-dvd-prod pairs; the converse classification is stated as SumDvdProdTriple but not proved.
(3,6) is the smallest such pair among the checked small cases.
Pair count is 0 for N <= 5 and positive for N >= 6.
open: Prove the bijectivity/classification direction for SumDvdProdTriple.
Prove pairCountAsymptotics, the Theta(N log N) density statement; the exact constant remains open.
